svg.title: Plot 126
svg.desc: Scatter plot of magnitude (jittered) against month of 2024, colored by depth. x from 1 to 13, y from 4 to 9. 6,397 points.

svg.style: --axis-line: #94a3b8; --axis-halo: #111827; font: 400 14px "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgb(229, 231, 235); fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; paint-order: normal; opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; position: static;
